Parameter Configuration Approach:
[person] clarified that the parameters used in v0.0.1/v0.0.2 were based on the custom assay and XP’s assay from the feasibility runs. These parameters have since been refined, and the final parameter set was provided as complete INI files rather than as individual parameter updates/removals.

3. Empty Variants Grid:
The Variants Grid was empty even though the snp_variant, cnv_variant, fusion_variant, and corresponding selected_*_variants tables contained data. For the affected variome, rdx_annotation_data remained NULL for all variant categories.
The getProcessedAnnotationKeys() NPE observed while loading the grid was a downstream symptom.

at java.util.ArrayList.forEach(ArrayList.java:1540) ~[?:?]
In v0.0.3, annotator.functional.all.alt.alleles=true caused AnnotatorActor to generate a protein consequence (p.Ser715del) for this genotype-negative allele. The resulting RefGene peptide-change object did not contain the functional-classification field f; Tahoe assumed it was non-null, threw an NPE, and rolled back the annotation transaction. Consequently, rdx_annotation_data was never populated and the Variants Grid remained empty.
A controlled v0.0.3 B2R run with only annotator.functional.all.alt.alleles=false changed the annotation back to splicesite_3, completed annotation processing, populated rdx_annotation_data, and restored the Variants Grid. This confirms the parameter change as the trigger.
